codex_usage.absent_usage: Processor returns default zero Usage when no thread usage update was received. Failed turns emit error without completed-turn usage; absent usage is unknown, not zero spending.
codex_usage.accounting: C and W are within I; R is within O. Validate nonnegative integral counts and C+W<=I; do not double count subsets.
codex_usage.cache_write_omission: Pinned SSE parser defaults missing cache_write_tokens to zero; native zero is not proof of explicit upstream zero.
codex_usage.cumulative_usage: exec JSONL processor copies last ThreadTokenUsage.total, which is cumulative. Use fresh sessions per attempt; do not sum cumulative updates/resumed-thread totals.

default_backend.selection_scope: to_api_provider lines 420-438 selects Codex base for Chatgpt, ChatgptAuthTokens, Headers, AgentIdentity and PersonalAccessToken; API-key mode defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1. Configured provider base_url can override.

default_chatgpt_oauth_refresh.proactive_scope: Managed Chatgpt auth only: token expiry within5min, or fallback last_refresh older8days; other auth modes differ.
default_chatgpt_oauth_refresh.refresh_call_scope: request_chatgpt_token_refresh lines 1625-1648 uses endpoint; explicit environment override possible in lines 1726-1728.

codex_usage.model_request_count_reason: exec JSONL usage has no per-request count. Protocol defines best-effort per-completed-response records but their presence in exec JSONL is not established. Tool-command count cannot substitute.
codex_usage.routing_scope: Client sentinel prevents catalog defaults and is omitted from outbound tier field; server-confirmed tier/tariff remains unknown.

discovery_engineering_conclusions.bm25_caveat: Lexical ranking with corpus-length/frequency effects, IDF floor and negative score sign; not semantic correctness or confidence. Outer result filtering does not restrict FTS table statistics.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.broad_lexical_origin: Retain raw-text discovery for files without extracted symbols; comments/literals may propose candidates but cannot prove runtime relevance.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.dependency_graph: State extracted resolved-direct production coverage only; incomplete/unresolved/dynamic graph is not complete closure. Required-context uncertainty within an all-or-nothing delivery contract must preserve fallback.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.freshness: Revalidate winner and losing competitor current hashes plus policy before delivery.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.overflow: Use a sentinel row/equivalent complete bounded enumeration; disclose truncation and missing query-term coverage. Top-k is not proof of absent competitors or semantic recall.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.parse_errors: Separate complete lexical inventory from per-file parse status. Unrelated syntax errors/unsupported files outside plausible task candidates need not block. Candidate errors remain unknown evidence.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.production_scope: Filter project and production eligibility before every discovery cap; do not filter only after mixed-pool top-k.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.resource_limits: Result LIMIT alone is insufficient: combine SQL VM/progress limits with time, rows/bytes, parser/process bounds; do not claim hard RSS or end-to-end lock/filesystem deadlines without evidence.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.status: Design conclusions and caveats, not measured efficacy or externally proved semantic completeness.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.tree_sitter_caveat: Recovered syntax tree may contain ERROR or MISSING nodes; syntax fields/ranges do not prove execution/type erasure or dependency completeness. Current upstream API may differ from installed versions.
discovery_engineering_conclusions.unknown_competitors: Never silently discard an unparseable/unsupported plausible competitor; abstain unless an independently sound decision-compatible upper bound excludes it.

matched_experiment_requirements: Same task, source baseline, model, reasoning, requested tier, budgets and independent grading in both arms.
Fresh sessions per attempt; counterbalance order and preserve failures/timeouts and development attempts separately.
Actual automatic Memglide preparation and unchanged coding task; report preload/abstention and preparation costs.
Actual independently graded behavior; process exit and syntax validity alone do not establish correctness.
End-to-end wall latency includes preparation and failures; token outputs retain categories and availability.
Conditional historical-price API equivalent reported separately from actual billing and complete spend availability.
No transfer of prior cohort/paper improvements; conclusions limited to recorded tasks and conditions.

network.runtime_status_observed: connected/running; no configured capabilities, secrets, runtime variables or outbound identities reported

pricing.context_scope: Per model request, full-request rates. Aggregate above threshold cannot locate qualifying calls. Aggregate below threshold bounds included completed calls only; missing request usage remains unknown.
pricing.cost_per_success: All arm attempt costs including failures / independently successful tasks; zero successes undefined. Missing failure/request usage prevents complete cost.
pricing.estimate_label: Conditional API list-price-equivalent estimate using historically verified Oct18 rates; current applicability and actual CLI account billing unverified.
